test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct sentence:

(1) They revised thoroughly.

(2) The test was challenging.

(3) Their preparation paid off.

(4) Most of them scored well.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (1)** i.e. **1 → 2 → 3 → 4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Start with **part (1)**: "They revised thoroughly." — this establishes the students' action before the test.
 
• Follow with **part (2)**: "The test was challenging." — introduces the difficulty they faced.
 
• Then **part (3)**: "Their preparation paid off." — shows the result of their revision despite the challenge.
 
• End with **part (4)**: "Most of them scored well." — the final outcome of preparation and effort.

Therefore, the correct answer is **1 → 2 → 3 → 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (2 → 1 → 3 → 4):** Begins with the test being challenging before mentioning revision, which disrupts the cause-effect flow.
 
• **Option 3 (1 → 2 → 4 → 3):** Places the outcome "Most of them scored well" before stating that "Their preparation paid off," which reverses the logical explanation.
 
• **Option 4 (1 → 3 → 2 → 4):** Claims preparation paid off before mentioning the test's difficulty, weakening the contrast that makes the result meaningful.
